raw_and_published_hash_policy: raw_sources[].sha256 identifies the unchanged local execution evidence. published_sha256 identifies these JSON copies after formatting/path redaction. Internal report hashes continue to identify raw artifacts, including excluded binaries; the lightweight verifier does not claim to verify unavailable binaries or rerun models.
excluded_large_artifacts: RGB, feature arrays, checkpoint and basis binaries
Prediction-vector NPZs and the original full per-episode history JSON
Full followup source snapshots and per-mode duplicated learning-curve fields
independent_audit_scope: Historical independent audit reconstructed checkpoint/basis bindings and 720 scalar controls from saved vectors. verify_phase2_history.py checks only published bytes and calculable scalar consistency.
other_workstreams: pusht_preparation/ and gate_continuation/ have separate receipts and are outside this manifest; final software checks will be added separately.
